title: relay_queue: redundant peers Vec clone and storage
description: SmtpRelayQueue stores self.peers (Vec<SmtpRelayPeerConfig>) and also passes peers.clone() to PeerHealthState::new, which already stores the full peer list. The only use of self.peers is is_empty() in enqueue(). Idiomatic Rust: expose a peer_count or is_peers_empty helper on PeerHealthState and drop the redundant field + clone.
